# openmetadata_tag (Data Source)

Fetches an OpenMetadata Tag by its fully qualified name (Classification.TagName).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Tags are looked up by their fully qualified name: Classification.TagName
data "openmetadata_tag" "pii_sensitive" {
  name = "PII.Sensitive"
}

output "tag_id" {
  value = data.openmetadata_tag.pii_sensitive.id
}

output "tag_classification" {
  value = data.openmetadata_tag.pii_sensitive.classification
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Fully qualified name of the tag, e.g. "PII.Sensitive".

### Read-Only

- `classification` (String) Name of the parent classification.
- `description` (String) Description of the tag.
- `display_name` (String) Human-readable display name.
- `domains` (List of String) Fully qualified names of domains this tag belongs to.
- `fully_qualified_name` (String) Fully qualified name of the tag.
- `id` (String) UUID of the tag.
- `mutually_exclusive` (Boolean) Whether this tag is mutually exclusive within its classification.
- `owners` (Attributes List) Owners of this tag. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owners))

<a id="nestedatt--owners"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owners`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) UUID of the owner entity.
- `type` (String) Type of the owner (user or team).
